method.scenario: Enable qualifying PlayStation Platinums at unit weight using the existing curve, compare native versus minimum required trophy rarity.
method.rounding: Apply existing per-achievement rarity_multiplier, then cast the complete per-game sum to integer as in the live canonical calculator.
method.leaderboardBaseline: Hold cached global leaderboard totals fixed and add the per-game difference between the counterfactual and current calculations.
method.tieHandling: Deterministic user-ID tie break for audit positions, with native and proxy rank intervals and strict pair reversals reported separately.
method.exclusions: The 43 previously flagged NPWR identities and conflicting duplicate copies are excluded before the comparison.
method.scenarioScope: PlayStation completion contributions on the current global StatusXP leaderboard.
